value.rationale: The same natural two-periodic adaptive mesh that is zero-stable can amplify a strictly decaying real scalar mode for any fixed 0<lambda*h<1 when the ratio is large; stronger damping lambda*h>1 restores asymptotic stability. The exact coefficient 2/(1+q) and rational finite witness give a precise boundary between numerical stability mechanisms in a central stiff-solver method; this is not merely a parameter rename or trivial tiny gain.
